topology_reasoning: Two parallel waveguides with S-bend transitions. Each waveguide: input straight -> S-bend down/up to coupling region -> straight coupling section -> S-bend up/down to output -> output straight. The S-bends bring the waveguides close together in the center for evanescent coupling. Total footprint 120µm x 4µm.
function_defining_knobs: coupling_length - length of straight section where guides are close (controls power transfer)
coupling_gap - edge-to-edge gap between guides in coupling region (controls coupling strength)
sbend_length - horizontal extent of each S-bend (controls adiabaticity)
port_separation - vertical separation at input/output ports
